name: digital-foundry-downloader
description: DF Downloader is an application designed to download the latest Digital Foundry videos when they are available

scripts.build: npm run build -w df-downloader-common && npm run build -w df-downloader-ui && npm run build -w df-downloader-service && npm run get-ui -w df-downloader-service
scripts.remove:code: npx rimraf node_modules df-downloader-common/dist df-downloader-service/dist df-downloader-service/public df-downloader-ui/dist
scripts.remove:all: npm run remove:config && npm run remove:data && npm run remove:code
scripts.check-build: npm run check-build -w df-downloader-common && npm run check-build -w df-downloader-service && npm run check-build -w df-downloader-ui
